race.comment: Look to be two key chances here being the two horses who found one better last time out. KING TAGALOA (7) pushed forward when resuming last time and boxed on to be beaten 2.25 lengths at Seymour. Better for that and beautifully placed in this easier event. STEAL AWAY (11) progressed nicely last start when she worked home well to finish a close second over 1628m at Moe, which was an improvement on previous efforts. Well-placed and there is no reason she cannot find winning ways with an edge on KING TAGALOA at the draw. CHURCHILL LANE (4) missed the frame last start over 1600m at this track, finishing fifth. Looks a key trifecta player. PRIDE OF MANDY (10) was moderate last start when sixth over 1400m at Cranbourne but draws to run an improved race. CHOSEN POINT (3) did little on debut but has changed stables and trialled well since.
